lines: She had appeared on the way back home, after I had finished submitting my report about Amidahara Prison.
It was a person I had never seen before, but she was a student of Gosha Academy, and my senpai, going by the colour of the tie on her uniform.
She gave her name, and looked at me with not-particularly-friendly eyes.
It looked like she was waiting to see what kind of reaction I would give upon hearing her name.
That said, this was someone I didn't know, so I had no real way to react to it, though.
「Um, do you need something from me?」

I didn't assume that just because she was a beautiful senpai with a short haircut, that meant this was going to be a flirty conversation. But even among distinctly un-flirty conversations, this was the worst kind.
「Right. That's the senpai who wants to kill you.」
Nao-senpai sneered, slightly raising the corners of her lips.
「Is this about the Fuuma rebellion in early spring? Being the head of the clan, I can't exactly say I have no responsibility, but......」
「No, that's not your fault. I know that.」
It seemed to be something else.
「Then, is it the incident this summer, when Nisha assassins came aiming for my life?」
「I take it the guards died in horrible ways. I was informed of it by my Oniwaban after the whole thing was over.」
「There have been cases of that, too. If a Taimanin who died were my lover or something, I'd certainly have it in for you, wouldn't I?」
Looked like that one was wrong as well.
However, ever since spring, there had been a series of troublesome incidents occurring around me.
It was possible that I had incurred the ire of all sorts of people without me knowing it.
「Uhhh, if you could just tell me exactly what your reason is, I would be able to address it.」
Nao-senpai crossed her arms like she was slightly irritated that I was slow on the uptake.
「You're a thorn in my side, as it were. An irritating speck of grit in my eye.」
“Grit in my eye” was the most alien situation possible for me, the one-eyed “Diot”.
「You of course know about the new unit they've been considering setting up lately, right?」
「No, that's the first I've heard of it.」
The tone of Senpai's voice rose.
「I'm only hearing about this for the first time now. Hmm, so they're making another squad. Wonder what kind of squad it'll be?」
All I did was mutter that innocently, but that appeared to get on her nerves.
She suddenly stuck her face out towards me.
「You're awfully calm about it. I'm aiming for the position of commander of that new unit.」
「Yet you're the name that's being raised as the prime contender.」
「I can't tolerate that, so I'd like to kill you.」
That was quite a reason, too.
No wonder nothing had come to mind.
「You've been performing well for a first-year, haven't you?」
She spat out a line like that of some ill-tempered senpai in an old sports manga.
「Ehh?! Even if you say that...... I don't know about that squad, and I have my Independent Commando Unit......」
「I have a unit to lead too! This newly-founded squad will be selected from people with commander experience.」
So that was why I had been put on the list too.
But I doubted that meant I was the leading candidate.
I had just met with Asagi-sensei, and she hadn't said a word about that.
「You might not know this because you're so busy with your Independent Commando Unit, but I'm commander of the “Gosha Public Order Unit”.」
Their primary function was to maintain civic order in Gosha.
It was like the military police in the armed forces, or the disciplinary committee in a school.
Naturally, their field of activity centred around territory within Gosha.
It was understandable that I had never met them on missions, since I was sent outside a lot of the time.

And, despite her saying with her mouth that it had nothing to do with this, I could easily tell that Senpai wasn't particularly friendly towards me because I was connected to various incidents within Gosha.
「Are you aware? Murders have been taking place in Gosha. Serial killings, at that.」
「I'd like to test you out. To see whether or not it's righteous for you to be getting a higher evaluation than me.」
「Huh? Please, wait a sec. Isn't that logic a little absurd?」
「What's absurd is that you seem to be valued more highly than I am.」
「After school tomorrow. I'll have you show me your so-called strength!」
Nao-senpai said sharply, and left without even waiting for my reply.
I'd gotten mixed up with a difficult person, huh?
She was such a beauty, but still...
I wanted to stand her up if possible, but it felt like if I did that, that kind of person would pursue me all the more doggedly.
「I have no choice but to go, don't I......?」
